evidence.quote: Mendeley Data is the Elsevier open generalist data repository to create, share and access FAIR data globally provided free to journal authors and researchers
Mendeley Data supports harvesting our entire repository of public dataset records using the Open Archives Initiative Protocol for Metadata Harvesting (OAI-PMH) standard.
